title: Means of ten resistors
intro: A production line makes resistors rated 100 Ω. Their resistances are normal with mean μ = 100 Ω and standard deviation σ = 2 Ω. The computer took **2000 samples of n = 10 resistors** (seed 1) and worked out the mean of each sample. The histogram shows the 2000 sample means: the sampling distribution of x̄.
